review_notes: I read the whole 124-line file and checked it against the repeated-proof-machinery rubric only. The proofs are short. They are mostly `ext; simp`, `aesop`, or `rfl`. `freeObjDesc.naturality`, `freeAdjunctionUnit.naturality`, `freeHomEquiv.left_inv` and `right_inv`, and the `homEquiv_naturality_left_symm` proof each use different simp sets and different goals. None repeats a nontrivial argument that a shared lemma could replace. The only repetition is the expression `freeAdjunctionUnit R F ≫ Functor.whiskerRight ((toPresheaf _).map ψ) _`. It appears in `freeHomEquiv.toFun` and twice in the statement of `free_hom_ext`. That is repeated statement text, not repeated proof reasoning, so it is too small to count under the rubric. I did not open the imported files for further duplication, because the rubric needs the repetition to be inside this file's proofs. Nothing in the file qualifies, so I report no finding.
